rationale.hitl-workflow: Mandatory human security review gates module certification and release.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Automated provenance, dependency, static-analysis, contract, and sandbox checks vet modules.
rationale.formal-methods: Higher assurance tiers apply formal reasoning and machine-checkable contracts.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent attestations and transparency logs make modules and builds auditable.
rationale.org-governance: Certification teams, assurance tiers, multi-party review, and repository policies govern modules.
